sql.ahj.permit.detailByAhj: WITH metroAreasWithStates AS ( select lov.id as "metro_area_id", s.id as "state_id", s.state from flow.list_of_value lov inner join flow.state s on s.abbreviation = substring(lov.name from 1 for 2) where lov.parent_id = 172 and lov.archived is false ) SELECT p.*, ahj.metro_area_id, maws.state_id, maws.state AS "stateName", coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(contacts))) FROM ( SELECT c.id, c.name, c.title, c.email, c.phone_number AS "phoneNumber", c.address, c.notes, c.hours FROM brs.ahj_contact c INNER JOIN brs.ahj_permit_contact apc ON c.id = apc.ahj_contact_id WHERE apc.ahj_permit_id = p.id AND c.archived IS FALSE AND c.contact_type_id = 1 ) contacts), '[]' ) AS submissionContacts, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(contacts))) FROM ( SELECT c.id, c.name, c.title, c.email, c.phone_number AS "phoneNumber", c.address, c.notes, c.hours FROM brs.ahj_contact c INNER JOIN brs.ahj_permit_contact apc ON c.id = apc.ahj_contact_id WHERE apc.ahj_permit_id = p.id AND c.archived IS FALSE AND c.contact_type_id = 6 ) contacts), '[]' ) AS followUpContacts, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(contacts))) FROM ( SELECT c.id, c.name, c.title, c.email, c.phone_number AS "phoneNumber", c.address, c.notes, c.hours FROM brs.ahj_contact c INNER JOIN brs.ahj_permit_contact apc ON c.id = apc.ahj_contact_id WHERE apc.ahj_permit_id = p.id AND c.archived IS FALSE AND c.contact_type_id = 7 ) contacts), '[]' ) AS printLocations, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(notes))) FROM ( SELECT n.id, n.note, n.date_created, n.date_modified, n.created_by_id AS "createdById", concat(created_by.first_name, ' ', created_by.last_name) AS "createdBy", n.modified_by_id AS "modifiedById", concat(modified_by.first_name, ' ', modified_by.last_name) AS "modifiedBy" FROM brs.ahj_note n INNER JOIN flow."user" created_by ON n.created_by_id = created_by.id INNER JOIN flow."user" modified_by ON n.modified_by_id = modified_by.id INNER JOIN brs.ahj_permit_note apn ON n.id = apn.ahj_note_id WHERE apn.ahj_permit_id = p.id AND n.archived IS FALSE AND n.note_type_id = 1 ) AS notes), '[]' ) AS notes, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(checklist))) FROM ( SELECT ac.id, ac.description, ac.display_order AS "displayOrder" FROM brs.ahj_checklist ac INNER JOIN brs.ahj_permit_checklist apc ON ac.id = apc.ahj_checklist_id WHERE ac.archived IS FALSE AND ac.checklist_type_id = 1 AND apc.ahj_permit_id = p.id ORDER BY ac.display_order) checklist ), '[]' ) AS submissionChecklist, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(checklist))) FROM ( SELECT ac.id, ac.description, ac.display_order AS "displayOrder" FROM brs.ahj_checklist ac INNER JOIN brs.ahj_permit_checklist apc ON ac.id = apc.ahj_checklist_id WHERE ac.archived IS FALSE AND ac.checklist_type_id = 2 AND apc.ahj_permit_id = p.id ORDER BY ac.display_order) checklist ), '[]' ) AS revisionChecklist, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(checklist))) FROM ( SELECT ac.id, ac.description, ac.display_order AS "displayOrder" FROM brs.ahj_checklist ac INNER JOIN brs.ahj_permit_checklist apc ON ac.id = apc.ahj_checklist_id WHERE ac.archived IS FALSE AND ac.checklist_type_id = 3 AND apc.ahj_permit_id = p.id ORDER BY ac.display_order) checklist ), '[]' ) AS asBuiltChecklist, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(links))) FROM ( SELECT apl.id, apl.link_type_id, apl.name, apl.link, apl.username, apl.password, apl.notes FROM brs.ahj_permit_link apl WHERE apl.archived IS FALSE AND apl.link_type_id = 4 AND apl.ahj_permit_id = p.id) links ), '[]' ) AS submissionLinks, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(links))) FROM ( SELECT apl.id, apl.link_type_id, apl.name, apl.link, apl.username, apl.password, apl.notes FROM brs.ahj_permit_link apl WHERE apl.archived IS FALSE AND apl.link_type_id = 5 AND apl.ahj_permit_id = p.id) links ), '[]' ) AS followUpLinks, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(fots))) FROM ( SELECT upv.user_id AS "id", upv.first_name AS "firstName", upv.last_name AS "lastName", concat(upv.first_name,' ',upv.last_name) AS "fullName", (select array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(fots))) from (select o.id AS "orgId", upv.org_level_id AS "orgLevelId", o.org_name AS "orgName", upv.position_level AS "positionLevel" from flow.org o where o.id = upv.org_id) fots ) AS "hierarchy" FROM flow.user_positions_vw upv INNER JOIN flow.org o ON o.id = upv.org_id LEFT JOIN flow.organization_custom_field_value ocfv ON ocfv.org_id = o.id LEFT JOIN brs.ahj ON ahj.metro_area_id = ocfv.int_value WHERE upv.end_date IS NULL AND upv.user_archived IS FALSE AND upv.primary_flag IS TRUE AND o.org_type_id = 8 AND ahj.id = p.ahj_id) fots ), '[]' ) AS servicingFots FROM brs.ahj_permit p INNER JOIN brs.ahj ahj ON ahj.id = p.ahj_id LEFT JOIN metroAreasWithStates maws ON maws.metro_area_id = ahj.metro_area_id WHERE p.ahj_id = :ahjId
sql.ahj.permit.createBlank: INSERT INTO brs.ahj_permit (ahj_id, deposit_amount, average_permit_fee, engineering_letter_required, print_location, stamped_plan, archived, date_created, created_by_id, business_license_expiration_date, contractor_license_expiration_date, business_license, contractor_license) VALUES (:ahjId, null, null, null, null, null, false, now(), :currentUser, null, null, null, null) RETURNING id
sql.ahj.permit.create: INSERT INTO brs.ahj_permit (ahj_id, deposit_amount, average_permit_fee, engineering_letter_required, print_location, stamped_plan, date_created, created_by_id, business_license, contractor_license, business_license_expiration_date, contractor_license_expiration_date) VALUES (:ahjId, :depositAmount, :averagePermitFee, :engineeringLetterRequired, :printLocation, :stampedPlan, now(), :currentUser, :businessLicense, :contractorLicense, :businessLicenseExpirationDate, :contractorLicenseExpirationDate)
sql.ahj.permit.update:
UPDATE brs.ahj_permit SET ahj_id = :ahjId, deposit_amount = :depositAmount, average_permit_fee = :averagePermitFee, engineering_letter_required = :engineeringLetterRequired, print_location = :printLocation, stamped_plan = :stampedPlan, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUser, business_license = :businessLicense, contractor_license = :contractorLicense, business_license_expiration_date = :businessLicenseExpirationDate, contractor_license_expiration_date = :contractorLicenseExpirationDate, other_license = :otherLicense, other_license_expiration_date = :otherLicenseExpirationDate, revision_fee_amount = :revisionFeeAmount, as_built_fee_amount = :asBuiltFeeAmount, follow_up_fee_amount = :followUpFeeAmount, delivery_fee_amount = :deliveryFeeAmount, approval_timeline = :approvalTimeline, documents_available = :documentsAvailable, brs_technician_permit_submission_instructions = :brsTechnicianPermitSubmissionInstructions, cancellation_and_refund_instructions = :cancellationAndRefundInstructions, brs_technician_permit_pickup_and_delivery_instructions = :brsTechnicianPermitPickupAndDeliveryInstructions, approval_instructions = :approvalInstructions,
submission_note = :submissionNote, revision_note = :revisionNote, as_built_note = :asBuiltNote, delivery_note = :deliveryNote WHERE id = :id
sql.ahj.permit.updateAllAhjPermitsInState:
UPDATE brs.ahj_permit SET deposit_amount = :depositAmount, average_permit_fee = :averagePermitFee, engineering_letter_required = :engineeringLetterRequired, print_location = :printLocation, stamped_plan = :stampedPlan, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUser, business_license = :businessLicense, contractor_license = :contractorLicense, business_license_expiration_date = :businessLicenseExpirationDate, contractor_license_expiration_date = :contractorLicenseExpirationDate, other_license = :otherLicense, other_license_expiration_date = :otherLicenseExpirationDate, revision_fee_amount = :revisionFeeAmount, as_built_fee_amount = :asBuiltFeeAmount, follow_up_fee_amount = :followUpFeeAmount, delivery_fee_amount = :deliveryFeeAmount, approval_timeline = :approvalTimeline, documents_available = :documentsAvailable, brs_technician_permit_submission_instructions = :brsTechnicianPermitSubmissionInstructions, cancellation_and_refund_instructions = :cancellationAndRefundInstructions, brs_technician_permit_pickup_and_delivery_instructions = :brsTechnicianPermitPickupAndDeliveryInstructions, approval_instructions = :approvalInstructions,
submission_note = :submissionNote, revision_note = :revisionNote, as_built_note = :asBuiltNote, delivery_note = :deliveryNote WHERE ahj_id IN (:ahjIds)
sql.ahj.permit.searchAhjsByState: WITH metroAreasWithStates AS ( select lov.id as "metro_area_id", s.id as "state_id" from flow.list_of_value lov inner join flow.state s on s.abbreviation = substring(lov.name from 1 for 2) where lov.parent_id = 172 and lov.archived is false ) SELECT p.id, p.ahj_id FROM brs.ahj_permit p INNER JOIN brs.ahj ahj ON ahj.id = p.ahj_id LEFT JOIN metroAreasWithStates maws ON maws.metro_area_id = ahj.metro_area_id WHERE maws.state_id = :stateId AND ahj.archived IS FALSE
sql.ahj.permit.link.create: INSERT INTO brs.ahj_permit_link (ahj_permit_id, name, link, username, password, notes, date_created, created_by_id, link_type_id) VALUES (:ahjPermitId, :name, :link, :username, :password, :notes, now(), :currentUser, :linkTypeId)
sql.ahj.permit.link.update: UPDATE brs.ahj_permit_link SET ahj_permit_id = :ahjPermitId, name = :name, link = :link, username = :username, password = :password, notes = :notes, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUser WHERE id = :id
sql.ahj.permit.link.delete: UPDATE brs.ahj_permit_link SET archived = TRUE, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :currentUser WHERE id = :id
